description: Reusable AI behavior-tree regression profiles. Each entry points to a YAML source and generated NodeCanvas asset.

profiles.name: CraftAllUsefulItems
profiles.description: Craft the best reachable useful item, gathering missing materials as needed.

profiles.name: ForageHerbsAndSeedsLoop
profiles.description: Repeatedly gather herbs and seed resources to validate plant forage paths.

profiles.name: GatherStarterSuppliesLoop
profiles.description: Prefer wood and rock, then fall back to forage resources.

profiles.name: GatherWoodAndRockLoop
profiles.description: Minimal early-game material collection loop for movement and pickup validation.

profiles.name: PotionRedPrepLoop
profiles.description: Prepare red potion crafting by making vials and gathering herbs, mushrooms, and fallback rock.

profiles.name: ToolProgressionLoop
profiles.description: Progress toward a pickaxe by crafting when ready or gathering core materials.

profiles.name: WildPantryRotationLoop
profiles.description: Rotate between forage plants and useful craft materials using FlipSelector.
